snippet.title: Planet Zoo: Asia Animal Pack - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: The Planet Zoo: Asia Animal Pack is available now on PC. Watch the latest Planet Zoo trailer to see what to expect with the Planet Zoo: Asia Animal pack, which features the honey badger, lion-tailed macaque, and Père David's deer. The Asia Animal pack also features over 100 scenery pieces and a new campaign scenario, where you will assist Dominic Myers with getting his South Korean Zoo up and running.
